title: BLCA_Cx_1
extract_protocol_ch1: High Pure FFPET RNA isolation kit (Roche)
label_protocol_ch1: SensationPlus FFPE Amplification and WT labeling kit
hyb_protocol: Samples were hybridized using Affymetrix hybridization kit materials • Heat cocktails at 99° for 5 minutes, then 42° for 5 minutes centrifuge at max speed for 1 minute (N.B. this deviates from Affy SOP). • Transfer 200μl of hyb solution to each array, then tape holes and parafilm. • Hybridize 16 hours at 45° at 60rpm• Fluidics washing is FS450_0001
data_processing: Data were processed using Bioconductor R package Affy. Probe intensities were normalized in labeling batches of 24 using RMA. Batches were combined and RMA normalized. | The file Processed_Data_Supplement.txt contains ready-to-use median centered gene expression data for 307 tumor samples, with EntrezID and GeneSymbol. Sample order is derived from ConsensusClusterPlus, performed on the top 50% variance genes (n=7031) and matches the Sjodahl 2017 publication. label_protocol_ch1: SensationPlus FFPE Amplification and WT labeling kit

Sample order is derived from ConsensusClusterPlus, performed on the top 50% variance genes (n=7031) and matches the Sjodahl 2017 publication.
